visualReview.notes: All ten portable images inspected. Eight jacketed radial ribs connect the flared plinth, three braces and expanded service room. All sixteen upper ports and four shaft windows remain open. Gallery scalloped supports and hoop pickets, lantern diamond glazing, visible optical representation, white dome/vane, entrance and four steps agree with accepted authority/archival photographs. The original 68696-triangle source master is byte-identical.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: All ten final shared/geographic images inspected. Canonical plaster, painted metal and granite graphs each read once; concrete-jacket surface has subtle scale and a coherent red finish, metal remains distinct, granite is confined to the ground ring and steps. Transparent lantern glass retains visible interior optical representation. Corrected placement camera includes the real mapped approach-road line east/northeast of the tower. It is labelled as context, not a surveyed entrance or footprint. Unload disposes all model geometry.

mediumFiReview.notes: All twenty-six final medium-fi images inspected. Four same-camera transitions preserve the tower height, expanded drum, eight-rib silhouette and white dome. Street and closeup have regular component-resampled dome facets, real recessed apertures, diamond glazing and gallery hoops without generic-decimation crumpling. District reduces gallery brackets and repeated small fittings; skyline uses opaque simplified glazing and a broad stair mass. Noon/late and economy/high views fit the synthetic Swedish-cottage palette. Distant untextured silhouette is fogged, while the useful skyline view retains red/white contrast.

geographicReview.notes: National aid 673 fixes center 22.05526516,58.9400605 and 27.2 m above base, separate from focal elevation 35.9 m above chart zero. Exact-QID OSM node 3369819188 confirms identity but is about 2.3 m east and 1.2 m south; the authority anchor is retained. Heading 0.7853981634 puts the native +Z doorway in the southeast quadrant, reconstructed from the inspected 2014 aerial and archival station layout. It is not a surveyed entrance bearing. The dated 2026-09-28 road snapshot is genuine station context and not an entry line. Native Y=0 contacts host terrain; the flat fixture establishes no surveyed coastal/foundation elevation.

fidelityReview.notes: Accepted medium-fi exterior follows the genuine national-aid photograph, society aerial, National Archives 1925 section and genuine April 2026 pre-restoration close photograph. The July reopening article confirms completed restoration in text; its lead image depicts Mehikoorma and has been excluded as a Ristna visual reference. Published total height and 5 m service drum constrain the component reconstruction; small fittings and entrance direction remain photo-proportioned. Original detailed master and unrelated Baltic masters are preserved. No survey-level dimensions, detached station buildings, operational navigation light, interiors or unobserved post-restoration vent changes are claimed.

geometryValidation.tests: Three focused tests passed: rays through sixteen service ports and four shaft windows retain actual recesses in both near levels; original master hash, national dimensions and reconstructed placement frame remain explicit; all four independent browser files rebuild identically within triangle, draw and download budgets and retain three canonical shared graphs.
geometryValidation.notes: Six final GLBs passed Khronos validation with zero errors, zero warnings and zero embedded images. Source/import retain 68696 triangles. Authored browser levels contain 998/3442/14278/41242 triangles, below all four strict caps. Near-level ray tests prove all sixteen service apertures and four shaft windows are recessed. Four browser files are byte-reproducible, using separate attribute streams and at most five draws.

runtimeLodReview.notes: Initial skyline plus district totals 319320 bytes; street 1088544 and closeup 3211424 bytes. Three canonical 256-square graphs are shared; their measured means are baked into skyline. Four separate browser levels use 1/4/5/5 draws and separate attribute streams. Declared 0.5/0.25/0.12/0.04 m allowances reserve faceting and omitted fine fittings; they are not a measured whole-mesh Hausdorff bound. Physical phone/laptop timings remain unmeasured.

limitations: The modeled exterior follows the cited published facts and inspected photographs. Unpublished dimensions and local fittings are explicitly photo-proportioned; no claim of engineering survey accuracy is made.
Portable PBR and shared metric surfaces are provided. Surface weathering, material color under local lighting and fine facade relief require close render review before maximum-detail acceptance.
